Exam Date & Time: 09-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  EMBEDDED SYSTEM DESIGN [ECE-4411]  
Marks: 50                                                                            Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           An embedded-system designer must balance multiple design metrics while ensuring  
  the required functionality of the system. Analyze how the optimization of one design  
  (5)  
  metric might impact others, using suitable examples.  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the following IC technologies used to implement a processor. Elaborate the  
  parameters of performance, design and cost  
  i. Full custom/VLSI                                                                      (5)  
  ii. Semi custom ASIC  
  iii. PLD  
  
2)           Compare the four common software architectures used in embedded systems by  
  applying your understanding of their structure, functionality, and suitability for  
  (4)  
  different applications. Provide relevant examples to support your comparison.  
  A)  
  B)      Three processes with process IDs PI, P2, P3 with estimated completion time 10, 5, 7  
  milliseconds and priorities 0, 3, 2 {0-highest priority, 3-lowest priority) respectively  
  enters the ready queue together. Calculate the waiting time and Turn Around Time  
  (TAT) for each process and the Average waiting time and Turn Around Time                 (3)  
  (Assuming there is no I/O waiting for the processes) in priority based scheduling  
  algorithm.  
  
  C)      Using appropriate code examples, apply your understanding of task synchronization  
  to explain common issues such as race conditions and deadlocks.                          (3)  
  
3)           With suitable diagram illustrate the following circuits essential for the proper  
  functioning of the processor/controller and firmware execution.  
  i. Watchdog Timer                                                                        (4)  
  A)      ii. Real Time Clock  
  
  B)      Differentiate between the Data Flow Graph (DFG) model and the Control Data Flow  
  Graph (CDFG) model. How are data and control operations represented in each     (3)  
  model? Support your answer with a suitable example.  
  
  C)      Demonstrate your understanding of out-of-circuit programming by explaining its role  
  in integrating hardware and software during embedded system development. Support (3)  
  your explanation with a relevant example and its sequence of operations.  
  
4)           Apply your knowledge of pointers to write a C program that swaps two integers         (5)  
  using a function. Explain how pointers are used in your solution to achieve the swap.

A)  
  B)         Write a C program that uses a struct to store student records and sorts them by roll  
  number using bubble sort.                                                              (5)  
  
5)              Explain the concept of System on Chip (SoC) and its significance in modern  
  embedded systems. Provide examples of applications where SoCs are commonly  
  (5)  
  used.  
  A)  
  B)         Elaborate the 3 primary objectives of EDLC                                             (5)  
  
-----End-----
